meta.title: Detector M-D — Hero #3 Context-cascade + R2/R4 + stale-closure v2 + snapshot persist
notes: Order: verifiable/low-risk stories FIRST (context-cascade detector, AI provider, snapshot persist, stale-closure v2), then the HIGH-RISK R2 monolith traversal rewrite LAST with full detector-core regression each step.
Context-cascade uses the EXISTING walkFiberImpl (like reconciler-keys) to stay decoupled from the R2 rewrite.
S3 exit = ❄ data/issue surface FROZEN (heroes 1-3 + stale-closure done, traversal unified, AI provider pluggable).
AI provider BYOK: OpenAI/Anthropic direct calls are NETWORK — the live call is a humanGate; the provider selection + request-shaping + key storage are verifiable here.
humanGates: M-D.2: real network calls to OpenAI/Anthropic with a BYOK key (live AI response) — verified only the request construction + provider routing + key storage here.
M-D.1: migrate+delete the 3 legacy walkers onto walkFiber — needs live-React regression on a real app (not sandbox-verifiable).

stories.title: M-D.3 — Hero #3 context-cascade detector
acceptanceCriteria: src/inject/detectors/context-cascade.ts conforms to the Detector interface; tracks Context.Provider value reference identity across commits and counts consumers; flags when the value reference changes every commit AND >=2 consumers re-render.
Emits Issue{ type:'CONTEXT_CASCADE', component, suggestion } — 'CONTEXT_CASCADE' added additively to IssueType.

test/fixtures/context-cascade/ positive (new value object every render, >=2 consumers) + negative (useMemo'd value); registry-harness test asserts one CONTEXT_CASCADE on positive, zero on negative (memoized).
Registered in detectors/index.ts; confidence declared + added to KNOWN_DETECTORS_DEFAULTS; bench baseline recorded; CHANGELOG entry. npx tsc --noEmit exits 0 and the detector suite passes.

stories.title: M-D.4 — stale-closure-async detector v2
acceptanceCriteria: Extends closure detection to Promises + useCallback deps; emits Issue{ type:'STALE_CLOSURE_ASYNC', component, source } ('STALE_CLOSURE_ASYNC' added additively to IssueType).
test/fixtures/stale-closure-async/ positive + negative; a test asserts emit-on-positive and zero-on-negative.
CHANGELOG entry; npx tsc --noEmit exits 0 and the suite passes.

stories.title: M-D.2 — R4 AI provider abstraction (BYOK; live call = humanGate)
acceptanceCriteria: DEVIATION: the abstraction lives in a NEW module src/services/ai-provider.ts (not inside ai-client.ts) to avoid risky surgery on the working analyzeSnapshot. HostedProxyProvider reproduces analyzeSnapshot's exact request (${proxyUrl}/v1/chat/completions, OpenAI body) so it is behavior-preserving by construction; wiring analyzeSnapshot to route through selectProvider() is a follow-on. provider:none returns null (free tools unaffected).
src/services/ai-client.ts defines an AIProvider interface with HostedProxyProvider (preserves current token-optimizer + subscription-key behavior), OpenAIDirect, and AnthropicDirect implementations.
BYOK key stored under react_debugger_byok_v1 (chrome.storage.local) via a DI'd storage; provider:'none' leaves the free panel tools working.
Unit tests assert provider selection + request shaping (endpoint, headers, body) for each provider WITHOUT a live network call (fetch injected/mocked); HostedProxy path preserved.
npx tsc --noEmit exits 0 and the ai-client suite passes.

stories.title: M-D.5 — snapshot persistence (session)
acceptanceCriteria: DEVIATION: the DI-tested session-persistence helper (src/panel/snapshot-persistence.ts) is delivered + verified here; wiring it into the TimelineTab component is deferred to S4 (that view is rebuilt as the Profiler + its tests are re-authored there — avoids touching a pre-existing-failing component about to be replaced).
TimelineTab snapshot state persists to chrome.storage.session (survives tab switch + panel reload, NOT page reload).
A pure persistence helper (read/write session) is unit-tested with a DI'd storage; a test proves round-trip + that a missing entry yields the empty default.
npx tsc --noEmit exits 0 and the suite passes.

stories.title: M-D.1 — R2 unified fiber traversal (HIGH RISK — monolith rewrite, last)
acceptanceCriteria: AUTONOMOUS (done+verified): src/inject/core/fiber-traversal.ts exports walkFiber(root, visitors[], opts) with FiberVisitor {enter,exit}, per-visitor {skipSubtree}, per-visitor try/catch isolation, and deadline-yield + startAt resume. fiber-traversal.test.ts 5/5. tsc 0, build 0.

HUMAN GATE (environment): migrating the 3 legacy monolith walkers (snapshot capture, scan walker, Redux store finder) onto walkFiber and DELETING their bodies requires live-React regression (their behavior is not sandbox-verifiable — no live React tree; detector tests use hand-built fibers). Not blind-deleted here; migration + deletion is done on a real app by the maintainer, one walker at a time under regression.
